rows.name: Cash Management Achievements: month-end cash, bank and investment balances, July 1980 - June 1981
rows.printed_heading: CASH MANAGEMENT ACHIEVEMENTS / TOWN OF LUNENBURG / For Fiscal Year Ending June 30, 1981
rows.what_it_is: NEW DATASET: the State-required chart of month-end balances: cash on hand, cash in non-interest and interest-bearing bank accounts, investments, total, and the amount exempt from investment. Non-interest balances are overdrawn (parentheses) most months. Rows 13-17 are the totals, the exempt deduction, the net totals, average balances and percentages. The note below the table (Total Bank and Investment Income $190,478; effect on tax rate $2.35) is prose, not read here. The column checks are off: the deduction row (Less: Total Exempt from Investment) is not a total of the months, so the validator groups them wrongly. Checked by hand from the cells in the worker log: each column of the twelve months sums to its TOTALS row, and TOTALS less the exempt amount gives the NET TOTALS (1,845,606 - 1,568,730 = 276,876; 15,924,412 - 1,568,730 = 14,355,682)
rows.columns: CASH ON HAND | MONTH END Cash in NON-INTEREST bearing accts | BALANCES Banks INTEREST bearing acets | INVESTMENTS (CDs, treas. bill's, repos MMDT, etc.) | TOTAL ALL CASH AND INVESTMENTS | CASH EXEMPT AMOUNT
